definition: Pre-irrigation reference VWC for one event.
formula_or_rule: Median VWC over the lookback window before irrigation_start; baseline_time is the last timestamp in that lookback window.

definition: Maximum post-irrigation VWC found in the search window for one event.
formula_or_rule: Maximum VWC after irrigation_start within the peak search window.

definition: Increase from baseline to peak for one event.
Estimated stabilized VWC below the maximum peak after irrigation for one event.
formula_or_rule: Median VWC over the detected plateau window; if no flat segment is found, use the fallback window after peak.

definition: Elapsed time from irrigation_start to peak VWC for one event.
Elapsed time from irrigation_start to plateau attainment for one event.
Additional time after irrigation shutoff before plateau is reached for one event.
Length of time irrigation water was running for one event.
Water delivered to the active strip pair/group.
formula_or_rule: Read from clean irrigation events table.

definition: Water assigned to one individual strip.
Average strip-level application flow rate during one irrigation event.
Point-in-time meter-needle flow at irrigation start, as recorded in the master workbook.
formula_or_rule: Master workbook FLOW RATE START; not photo-derived.

definition: Point-in-time meter-needle flow near irrigation end, as recorded in the master workbook.
formula_or_rule: Master workbook FLOW RATE END; not photo-derived.

definition: Calculated event-average flow delivered to the active strip group.
Diagnostic flag for a large difference between a workbook boundary-flow reading and calculated event-average group flow.
formula_or_rule: True when the largest available absolute difference exceeds both 50 GPM and 25% of avg_flow_gpm_group. Flow can vary during an event, so this flag requests review rather than declaring an error.

definition: Method used to estimate plateau_vwc for one event.
formula_or_rule: flat_segment = sustained low-slope zone found; fallback_window = delayed post-peak summary window used; no_peak = no meaningful wetting peak detected.

definition: Probe depth index in the logger naming convention.
Probe depth in inches.
Legacy profile-area-scaled VWC diagnostic. Use the three-zone storage output for whole-strip accounting.
Legacy diagnostic retained for compatibility; it is not the canonical three-zone strip storage fraction.
Legacy diagnostic retained for compatibility. Use the canonical unretained-water fields instead.
Applied irrigation not retained as increased soil-water storage in the measured 0-18 inch strip profile.
Fraction of applied strip water not retained.
Whether the event may be used for holding-capacity analysis.
formula_or_rule: Passes event QC and has a complete three-zone storage estimate.

definition: Reason holding-capacity eligibility passed or failed.
formula_or_rule: ok, event QC reason, or incomplete three-zone storage.

definition: Whether the event may be used for unretained-water analysis.
Reason unretained-water eligibility passed or failed.
formula_or_rule: ok, holding-capacity failure reason, missing/nonpositive applied water, or uncalculable residual.

definition: Whether unretained water may also be interpreted as an end-of-field upper-bound proxy. This is not measured runoff.
formula_or_rule: unretained_eligible and a nonnegative bottom-position 6-inch arrival delay is observed.

definition: Irrigation water not retained in the measured 0-18 inch profile for events with credible bottom arrival; an end-of-field upper-bound proxy, not measured runoff.
Reason end-of-field proxy eligibility passed or failed.
formula_or_rule: ok, unretained-water failure reason, missing bottom response, or bottom response before irrigation start.

definition: Fractional form of the eligible end-of-field unretained-water proxy; not a measured runoff fraction.
Operational target VWC based on historical plateau responses.
Recommended runtime in hours based on historical event response.
formula_or_rule: Median, mean, or p75 of time_to_plateau_hours within each group

definition: Recommended runtime in minutes based on historical event response.
